create_zero_shot_classifier: create a ZeroShotClassifier module that maps ROI features to zero-shot class scores using pretrained weight vectors
create_zero_shot_classifier_group: create a ZeroShotClassifierGroup module that supports multiple dataset sources for zero-shot classification during training
build_zero_shot_weights: build zero-shot classifier weights from .npy or .pth files with optional background class padding and L2 normalization
configure_from_detectron2_cfg: configure a ZeroShotClassifier or ZeroShotClassifierGroup instance from a Detectron2 config object and input shape spec
run_zero_shot_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the zero-shot classifier to compute cosine similarity scores between ROI features and class embeddings
